items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He said, listen there, Miss Mary, Mr. Mike.

ctx.x: All right, maybe I'll be able to play this record for him too.
All right. He said, listen there, Miss Mary, Mr. Mike. That sure is Miss Mary.
Well, almost all those boys, those musicians who have, were calling that were really born out in Louisiana. And they'd come to New Orleans and build up into this, these names for themselves.
